title: Broccoli Rabe, Pecorino and Anchovy Pizza
changes_from_base: Bitter broccoli rabe charred with olive oil and chilli flakes, salty anchovy strips and a pecorino and parmesan mix replace the fresh mozzarella and basil, baked in a home oven on a hot stone instead of a wood-fired oven.
summary: Neapolitan-style pizza topped with bitter charred broccoli rabe, salty anchovy fillets, and melted cheese, blistered in a very hot oven.

ingredients.item: pizza dough, shop-bought or homemade, divided into 4 balls
tinned whole peeled tomatoes, drained (juice kept)
fine sea salt or table salt
broccoli rabe (cime di rapa), ends trimmed
anchovy fillets in oil, drained and halved lengthways

steps.title: Rest Dough
steps.text: Leave the dough (900 g, in 4 balls) covered at room temperature 1-2 h.

steps.title: Heat Oven
steps.text: Put the pizza stone or steel on a shelf near the top and heat the oven to 260-280 °C for 45 min.

steps.title: Make Sauce
steps.text: Blend the drained tomatoes (800 g tinned) briefly into a coarse sauce, top up with saved juice to about 475 ml, season with salt (¼ tsp) and pepper (¼ tsp), mix parmesan (60 g) and pecorino (60 g) in a bowl.

steps.title: Prepare Greens
steps.text: Boil broccoli rabe (450 g) in salted water 2-3 min until tender, drain and squeeze dry, cool slightly and cut into 5-7 cm lengths, toss with oil (60 ml) and chilli flakes (½ tsp).

steps.title: Char
steps.text: Roast in an ovenproof pan in the hot oven, stirring often, 5-8 min until lightly charred.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Flour one dough ball well, press into a 20 cm round leaving a thicker 2.5 cm rim, stretch over the knuckles to about 25-30 cm and set on a floured peel.

steps.title: Top and Bake
steps.text: Spread a quarter of the sauce leaving a 1 cm border, lay a quarter of the anchovies (16 halved fillets), scatter a quarter of the cheese mix, add the charred rabe, drizzle with oil (15 ml), slide onto the stone and bake 6-9 min (switch the grill on for the last 1-2 min if the top is pale) until the rim is charred in spots and the base is crisp, repeat with remaining dough.

tips: Parboil the broccoli rabe before roasting to ensure it is completely tender by pizza time, so you don't end up with fibrous stalks
Using the grill function towards the end achieves that essential charred rim without burning the thin, crispy base
Contains anchovies (fish); for a fish-free pizza leave them off and add a little extra pecorino for saltiness.
storage: Best eaten straight away; any leftovers keep chilled for 1 day, though the crust will soften on storage. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
